summary: Vital Farms filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting entry into a $60.0 million senior secured asset-based revolving credit facility dated August 4, 2026, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent, sole bookrunner, and sole lead arranger. The facility replaced a prior 2024 credit facility with the same agent, which terminated concurrently. Interest is SOFR-based plus 2.50% initially, stepping down based on fixed charge coverage. Maturity is August 4, 2029, or 90 days before any outstanding term loan maturity. This is a routine refinancing of working-capital credit, not a special situation. Funds are for general corporate purposes; no share repurchases, acquisitions, or strategic changes are involved.
